capabilities: Assign a status set to a file, block, or heading
Cycle task statuses with a left-click on the status dot
Open a manual status picker via right-click
Remove completed-status tasks from the rendered note
Store each task's status as a single character in its checkbox brackets
disambiguation: It does not create or edit status sets; it only reads and applies sets defined in the Status Sets plugin.
extras: Full documentation lives on an external site linked from the README; the README explains the single-character checkbox format choice and points to the docs for its tradeoffs.
intentEvidence: A companion plugin to Status Sets — applies the same reusable status sets to checklist items inside your notes
problem: Obsidian checkboxes have only two states and one glyph, with no way to give tasks per-file, per-block, or per-heading multi-status icons and colors.

relations.evidence: This plugin reads status sets you define in Status Sets (file-folder-status-icons) — install and enable that first.

summary: Companion to Status Sets that applies its reusable status sets to checklist items in notes, replacing checkbox glyphs with traffic-light status icons.
